pages.title: Six String Studio — Guitar Lessons
pages.html:
🎸Six String Studio
AboutLessonsPricingTestimonialsFAQContact

Guitar Lessons That Make Practice Feel Like Play

Learn guitar at your own pace with friendly, personalized lessons in Riverside, CA — for complete beginners and seasoned players alike.

Book Your First Lesson

Meet Your Teacher

Hi, I'm Marcus Reed, founder of Six String Studio. I've been playing guitar for over 20 years and teaching for 12 of them, working with students from age 7 to 70. I hold a degree in Music Performance from UC Riverside and have played professionally in blues, rock, and jazz ensembles across Southern California.

My teaching philosophy is simple: lessons should be encouraging, practical, and tailored to what *you* want to play — whether that's campfire songs, blues solos, or your favorite pop hits.

What Lessons Involve

Beginner Foundations

Posture, chords, strumming patterns, and reading tablature. You'll be playing your first full song within two lessons.

Technique & Theory

Scales, fingerpicking, music theory basics, and ear training to help you understand the "why" behind the music.

Song Coaching

Work through songs you love, from acoustic singer-songwriter tunes to electric guitar solos, with personalized feedback.

Performance Prep

Get ready for open mics, recitals, or just playing confidently for friends and family.

Pricing

All lessons are held in-studio or online via video call. Save with a monthly package, or pay as you go.

Single Lesson

$45 / 45 min

  • No commitment
  • Great for trying lessons out
  • In-studio or online
Choose This Plan

Monthly Package

$160 / 4 lessons

  • Save $20 vs. single lessons
  • Weekly consistent progress
  • Priority scheduling
Choose This Plan

Family Package

$280 / 4 lessons, 2 students

  • Perfect for siblings or parent-child duos
  • Shared or separate sessions
  • In-studio only
Choose This Plan

What Students Say

"Marcus made learning guitar fun from day one. I went from never touching a guitar to playing full songs in three months."

— Dana W., adult beginner

"My son looks forward to his lesson every single week. Patient, encouraging, and genuinely skilled at teaching kids."

— Priya S., parent of student, age 9

"I'd played for years but felt stuck. Marcus helped me break through plateaus with theory I never understood before."

— Jordan T., intermediate player

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need my own guitar?

Yes, you'll need your own guitar for practice at home, but loaner guitars are available during in-studio lessons if you're just starting out and haven't purchased one yet.

What ages do you teach?

I teach students from age 7 through adult. Lessons are adapted to fit each student's age and learning style.

Do you offer online lessons?

Yes, online lessons via video call are available and work just as well as in-studio sessions for most skill levels.

What is your cancellation policy?

Please give at least 24 hours notice to reschedule a lesson without charge. Same-day cancellations are billed at the full lesson rate.

What genres do you teach?

Rock, blues, folk, pop, jazz basics, and classical fingerstyle — I tailor the material to whatever genre excites you most.

Get In Touch

Ready to start playing? Send a message and I'll get back to you within one business day to schedule your first lesson.

Studio Hours

  • Monday – Thursday 2:00 PM – 8:00 PM
  • Friday 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
  • Saturday 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM
  • Sunday Closed
